t: 教皇马丁 由于他反对一神论,我被逮捕并被带到君士坦丁堡.
te: Pope Martin I is arrested and taken to Constantinople, due to his opposition to monothelitism.
dz: 教皇马丁 由于他反对一神论,我被逮捕并被带到君士坦丁堡.
de: Pope Martin I is arrested and taken to Constantinople, due to his opposition to monothelitism.

t: 教宗马丁一世曾被拜占庭当局从罗马绑架来反对摩诺教,后被君士坦丁堡审判.
te: Pope Martin I, having been abducted by Byzantine authorities from Rome for his opposition to Monothelitism, is tried in…
dz: 教宗马丁一世曾被拜占庭当局从罗马绑架来反对摩诺教,后被君士坦丁堡审判.
de: Pope Martin I, having been abducted by Byzantine authorities from Rome for his opposition to Monothelitism, is tried in Constantinople.
